歷經7週激戰「Esports World Cup 2026」正式落幕。總冠軍由「AG.AL」獲得

2026年7月6日(一)至8月23日(日)期間，在 法國 ・ 巴黎 舉辦的「 Esports World Cup 2026 」 歷經為期7週各部門的激烈角逐，最終總冠軍的是以中國為據點的「 AG.AL 」。

「Esports World Cup 2026」落幕！榮獲總冠軍的是「AG.AL」

法國・巴黎舉辦的「Esports World Cup 2026」

為期7週在法國・巴黎舉辦的「 Esports World Cup 2026 」 本次為第三屆的大會，由超過100家廣播電視台等單位以 47 種語言進行轉播，累計收視人數達 8億5,000萬人 。 此外，在英雄聯盟錦標賽在高峰期曾創下 430萬人 的觀賽紀錄。 此外，電競賽事的門票銷售量較去年同期增長94%，達17萬5,000張；若將會場、粉絲嘉年華及城市活動納入計算，活動期間總訪客數更創下 200萬人次 的佳績。 使得自2025年大賽起取得了長足的進步。

由中國「AG.AL」獲勝

這屆「Esports World Cup 2026」已於2026年8月23日(日)落幕。 總冠軍的頭銜由以中國為據點的「 AG.AL 」獲得。 在作為最終週的第7週，曾連續兩年奪得俱樂部冠軍的Team Falcons雖以綜合排名榜首之姿出戰TrackMania，卻意外地在八強賽中遭淘汰。 隨後，緊追在後的 AG.AL 在TrackMania中精彩奪冠，贏得了 13 萬美元的錦標賽獎金，並拿下了Esports World Cup 2026俱樂部錦標賽的參賽資格 。

總排名

Clutching victory at the last minute, defying the odds, proving that nothing is granted and everything is earned. @AGGlobalEsports are the EWC26 Club Champions! 🏆 pic.twitter.com/4Q8BsRhu2Y

— Esports World Cup (@EWC_EN) August 23, 2026

第1名. AG.AL( @AGGlobalEsports )(5,300分)

第2名. Team Falcons( @TeamFalconsGG )(4,600分)

第3名. Team Vitality( @TeamVitality )(3,300分)

第4名. Natus Vincere( @natusvincere )(2,950分)

第5名. Team Liquid( @TeamLiquid )(2,700 分)

AG.AL各部門成績

第1名.「Trackmania」「TEKKEN 8」

第2名.「Chess」「Free Fire」「Honor of Kings World Cup」

第3名.「Teamfight Tactics」

法國總統艾曼紐·馬克宏亦出席了活動。對電競的未來寄予厚望

會場上 法國總統艾曼紐·馬克宏 ( @EmmanuelMacron )出席了活動，並向AG.AL的 凱登·雷會長 等人頒發獎盃。 馬克宏總統在自己的 X帳號 上發文表示「法國為今年夏天能在巴黎舉辦電競世界盃感到自豪！」，並向所有玩家表達了讚賞之情。 「Esports World Cup 2026」原本計畫在沙烏地阿拉伯舉辦，但因應當地局勢， 最終 最終改至法國舉行。

電競正日益風靡全球，並在大型舞台上備受矚目。 除了「Esports World Cup 2027」之外，也期待電競未來能進一步加速國際化發展。

電競基金會執行委員會主席 Faisal bin Bandar bin Sultan al Saud殿下的感言

We are proud of what the Esports World Cup has achieved in Paris and of its continued international growth. Bringing the EWC to a global audience beyond Saudi Arabia marks an important milestone in its journey and reflects the growing recognition of esports as a global industry, connecting communities, cultures and audiences around the world. The attendance of His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince and Prime Minister, alongside President Emmanuel Macron, is a testament to the growing importance and global interest in esports, and to how far the industry has come. I extend my congratulations to all the players, Clubs, publishers, partners and organisers who contributed to this edition. Paris has been an important chapter in the EWC journey, and we look forward to building on this progress in the years ahead.

AG.ALCOO Eddy Chen的感言

"When we began expanding AG.AL globally in 2024, the same year the Esports World Cup launched, we set out to build a Club capable of succeeding across games, regions and cultures. This title shows how far that vision has come. Our journey in Paris reflected the strength of the entire organization, from M. Zubair's breakthrough in TEKKEN 8 and our deep runs across multiple titles to Gwen delivering the decisive Trackmania victory under extraordinary pressure. But this trophy belongs equally to every player, coach and staff member whose dedication brought us here. I want to thank our Chairman, Mr. Layne Le, whose belief and leadership made this journey possible, and the Esports Foundation for creating a global stage that rewards the depth and ambition of an entire Club. Winning the Club Championship is a historic milestone for AG.AL and a proud moment for everyone who believed in what we are building.

電競財團CEO Ralf Reichert的感言

Our ambition has always been bigger than a single event: to grow esports and establish it as a leading global sport. The Esports World Cup brings that mission to life by bringing the best games, players, Clubs and communities together on one global stage. Paris embraced the Esports World Cup and made it its own. The city showed that competitive gaming belongs on the world's biggest stages while staying true to what makes esports special. Thank you to the city of Paris for seven weeks of incredible support and fandom. And congratulations to AG.AL on an extraordinary Club Championship victory and on earning their place in esports history.
